description: Independent publication settings for serial browser E2E. Paths resolve relative to this file. Publication requires the E2E snapshot and restoration lifecycle.

settings.persistenceConfig: Persistence configuration shared by the publication CLI and E2E server.
settings.visitorOrigin: Explicit local E2E server origin. The launcher must bind this address and must not silently reuse an existing server.
settings.preparedRoot: Generated publication inputs outside the tracked database, cleaned by the E2E lifecycle.
